name: subscribe__multi_chunk_burst_guaranteed
description: Locks the F5/F6 per-chunk handshake loop against a guaranteed multi-chunk initial burst. The many_temp_sensors topology lays out 30 bridged Temperature endpoints; a wildcard SubscribeRequest expands to ~360 AttributeReports — far past the 1100-byte chunk budget. The scenario asserts drain_subscribe_chunks consumes at least 2 ReportData chunks (each ACKed with a fresh StatusResponse) before the SubscribeResponse arrives. Without the F5/F6 fixes the bridge burst-fires all chunks, Apple's ReadClient state-machine collapses, and ProcessSubscribeResponse never triggers.
